claim.quote: I don’t think any of the horses that are in the race will particularly stumble. I don’t think you’ll look up and go, Wow, I thought Cursor was fantastic—and it’s just gone.
claim.author: Reid Hoffman
claim.context: None of the current coding-agent leaders will collapse or exit the market during 2026. Hoffman: none of the coding-agent leaders will stumble. Pinned because it directly contradicts Shipper's own Cursor call (c31).

state.criterion: None of the coding-agent leaders shut down, was acquired in distress or lost most of its users or revenue in 2026.
state.measure: Same list, reputable reporting dated 2026; provisional.

evidence_tiers.1: primary: official announcement, filing, shipped product, on-chain or price data, government statistics
evidence_tiers.2: reputable reporting: a major outlet or a domain-leading trade publication
evidence_tiers.3: market resolution: a Polymarket or Kalshi market on the question that resolved
evidence_tiers.4: author's own later statement: an admission of a miss is strong, a claim of a hit is weak
evidence_tiers.5: social chatter: posts or comments from people without standing; never sufficient alone

met.instructions: Given only the evidence listed in `evidence`, and measuring the way `measure` says, is the `criterion` met as of `as_of`?

criteria.true: At least one evidence item that supports the criterion comes from a source with standing (tier 1, 2 or 3, or a tier 4 admission by the author) and directly establishes what the criterion requires.
criteria.false: No evidence item with standing establishes the criterion. Items that are only about the same topic, that only predict, or that come from people without standing do not count.

contradicted.instructions: Given only the evidence listed in `evidence`, does the evidence show that the `criterion` was NOT met as of `as_of`?

criteria.true: At least one evidence item with standing reports the opposite of what the criterion requires, or reports that the required thing did not happen within the window.
criteria.false: Nothing in the evidence shows the criterion failed; the evidence may simply be silent or insufficient.

strength.instructions: How strong is the best evidence bearing on the `criterion`, considering source standing and directness?
